text:
Amelia H.: quick follow-up from the RFC: proposing a 'light adapter' at the edge to stitch v1 client payloads to the new v2 API shape instead of running a heavyweight proxy. goal: minimal per-request CPU, preserve streaming, and avoid client SDK churn. thoughts?

Jordy: curious — how "light" is light? do we mean header-based rewrites only or small JSON transforms too? what's the expected extra latency? :eyes:

Amelia H.: mostly header sniff + tiny shape rewrites (rename fields, map `prompt` -> `input_prompts[]` when single, wrap legacy batch into v2 streaming frames). worst-case added 2-6ms p95 on edge nodes in our estimates. no model-side changes.

Devon: infra note — keep an eye on connection reuse. adapter should be in the request path before upstream keepalive/pool selection. otherwise we blow up CPU from re-establishing backends. I sketched an env var to gate it: `EDGE_COMPAT_LIGHT_ADAPTER=true`.

Devon: sample config snippet I tested locally:
```
edge.service.adapters.light_adapter.enabled = true
edge.service.adapters.light_adapter.routes = ["/v1/generate", "/v1/embeddings"]
edge.service.adapters.light_adapter.log_level = "info"
```

Sara (SDK): SDK impact? we need to coordinate a minor SDK shim release to set the compatibility header when using older client helpers, otherwise we'll have silent rewrites. also telemetry: mark requests with `compat=light-adapter` so we can measure migration.

Amelia H.: agreed. plan: adapter will attach `X-Compat-Source: light-adapter-v1` and we add a telemetry flag `compat.adapter=light`. SDK team will opt-in for 2 weeks then flip server-side flag for canary.

mike-sre: ops question — fallback policy if adapter fails or mapping mismatch? we should fail fast and return 400 with structured error so clients can detect and retry with explicit v2. also add a metric `adapter.mapping_errors` to alert.

Amelia H.: yes — error semantics: 400 for invalid/ambiguous mapping, 522 (or 503?) for internal adapter errors with `Retry-After`. prefer 400 for mapping problems. add header `X-Compat-Error: mapping` when relevant.

Jordy: how about streaming? v1 clients expect blocking response, v2 streams tokens. do we buffer then stream, or do we translate frame-by-frame?

Amelia H.: we will translate frames directly where possible. for legacy batch endpoints that return a full result, adapter can emit a single-stream frame. for clients that do long-poll, we keep semantics. key is not to buffer entire model output on edge.

Devon: perf safeguard: if streaming translation would block beyond 100ms per-frame, fall back to buffered single-frame response and increment `adapter.fallback_to_buffered`. put circuit-breaker: after 0.5% fallback in 5m window, throttle new adapter-enabled connections.

Sara (SDK): migration plan sketch:
- week 0: announce in SDK changelog + compatibility guide
- week 1: opt-in SDK release sets `X-Compat-Client: sdk-v1-shim`
- week 2: enable server-side adapter for 1% tenants (ff.edge_compat_light_adapter = 1)
- week 3-4: ramp 1 -> 10 -> 50 -> 100 based on metrics
- week 5: deprecation warning header `X-Deprecation: v1 will be removed in 90 days`

Amelia H.: metrics to watch: `adapter.latency.p95`, `adapter.error_rate`, `adapter.mapping_errors`, `upstream.latency.delta`, `sdk.clients_using_compat`. also watch customer error pages and support tickets.

mike-sre: add SLO guardrail alert: if adapter adds >10ms p95 for a service route for more than 15m, auto-disable adapter on that route and page oncall.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge/adapters/light-adapter v0.1 -> staging (sha: 7a3f9e).

Devon: will run load test with 50k RPS simulation of small prompts to validate overhead. tagging observability task: ENG-RUNTIME-612.

Amelia H.: next steps + owners: Amelia (design + rollout), Devon (infra + load testing), Sara (SDK release + docs), Mike (SRE runbooks + alerts). I'll put a short RFC addendum with the wire mappings and sample errors. if no blockers, we aim to flip the 1% flag next Wednesday.

Jordy: ok from me. please include example curl for support team to repro.

Amelia H.: example repro: 
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Compat-Source: sdk-v1-shim' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello", "max_tokens":16}'
```

Sara (SDK): I'll draft the SDK note and compatibility FAQ. tagging me for follow-up. :thumbsup:

mike-sre: will prepare runbook snippet: if `adapter.mapping_errors > 10/m` for 5m, run `edgectl adapters disable light_adapter --route /v1/generate` and notify #incidents.

Amelia H.: thanks all — I'll post the addendum and the feature-flag rollout schedule in #eng-runtime this afternoon.
